properties.displayName: RDP low-and-slow brute force: 20+ failed logons in 24h, under 10 per hour
properties.description: Detects slow password guessing from one IP that stays below the hourly brute-force threshold.
properties.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4625 and IpAddress != "-" | summarize HourlyAttempts = count(), First = min(TimeGenerated), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by IpAddress, Hour = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) | summarize Attempts = sum(HourlyAttempts), ActiveHours = dcount(Hour), MaxPerHour = max(HourlyAttempts), FirstSeen = min(First), LastSeen = max(Last) by IpAddress | where Attempts >= 20 and ActiveHours >= 3 and MaxPerHour < 10
